items.headline: Citi commodities chief advises Gen10 CTRM
items.summary: Citibank's Global Head of Commodities Jose Cogolludo has joined the advisory board of Gen10, a vendor positioning its CommOS platform as an agentic, chat-driven CTRM system for physical commodity traders.

items.headline: Trafigura closes $4.4bn syndicated facility
items.summary: Trafigura closed an upsized, oversubscribed $4.4bn syndicated revolving credit and term loan package spanning USD and CNH tranches, adding a new five-year RCF to lengthen its funding maturity profile.

items.headline: ACER works to fix REMIT-EMIR reporting overlap
items.summary: ACER's public consultation on a new REMIT transaction-reporting annex addressing the REMIT/EMIR reporting overlap remains a live compliance issue, as firms await updated guidance on avoiding duplicate derivative reporting.

items.headline: Freight rates near post-Hormuz peak, Xeneta says
items.summary: Xeneta data show Far East-to-US spot freight rates have likely peaked after the post-Hormuz disruption, even as Persian Gulf route rates keep climbing amid ongoing regional shipping tensions.
